P3 becomes prerequisite-eligible but is not activated. H5, P3-P11, scientific/external execution, publication, and release remain inactive.

recommendation: Option A with the recorded limitations. The durable correction commit is 4bd5a607dda238475322e32207897512a73e20a0. actions.py contains seven unchanged public classes and zero private module definitions; intrinsic validation is directly owned. Seven class-owned software-verification modules contain 42 functions, 42 evidence owners, two helpers, and 103 collected cases. Historical IDs SV-PROV-046 through SV-PROV-055 and SV-PROV-073 retain their primary meanings through a semantic 11-to-11 map. Structural validation, 103 owned cases, 372 focused action/provenance cases, 507 complete focused P2 cases, 100% diagnostic actions.py branch coverage, Ruff, mypy, Sphinx, ownership/completion/checkpoint/H3/capability/local-route gates, protected hashes, and diff checks pass. The sole reviewer returned findings; one consolidated correction pass resolved them and was deterministically revalidated. Software verification does not establish file observation, provenance truth, external-execution validity, numerical verification, scientific validation, UQ, physical correctness, release readiness, or human acceptance.
blocked_scope: P2 closure and human acceptance; any further P2 mutation; H5 or P3-P11 activation; scientific or external-tool execution; publication; release.
